run_gmock_gen: run gmock_gen.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes to stdout
run_gmock_class: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file to generate mock classes for specified classes
generate_mock_methods: generate MOCK_METHOD macros for all virtual functions in a C++ class definition
generate_mock_class: generate a complete Google Mock class with MOCK_METHOD macros from a C++ header file
parse_cpp_ast: parse a C++ source file into an AST using the cpp.ast BuilderFromSource module
